facts.claim: Productivity and B2B SaaS apps hold 20% to 32% at day 30, against an average iOS app at 5.3%
facts.excerpt: For productivity and B2B SaaS apps, day-30 retention benchmarks are 20-32%. The average iOS app retention rate drops to 5.3% by day 30.

facts.claim: Business apps convert about 66.7% of App Store page views to installs
facts.source_title: ASO Conversion Rate Benchmarks by App Category
facts.excerpt: Business category shows approximately 66.7% page view to install conversion on App Store.

facts.claim: The business category records the highest download-to-trial rate of any app category
facts.excerpt: The business app category had the highest download to trial rate out of all categories covered in the State of Subscription Apps.

facts.claim: Fintech apps retain a median 28% at day 1, 12% at day 7 and 7% at day 30, with strong performers at 35-45%, 18-25% and 10-15%
facts.source_title: App Retention Benchmarks: How Your App Stacks Up by Industry
facts.excerpt: Fintech apps: strong performers 35-45% Day-1, 18-25% Day-7, 10-15% Day-30; medians 28%, 12% and 7%.

facts.claim: Social apps retain a median 40% at day 1, 18% at day 7 and 12% at day 30, with strong performers at 50-60%, 25-30% and 15-20%
facts.source_title: App Retention Benchmarks: How Your App Stacks Up by Industry
facts.excerpt: Social apps: strong performers 50-60% Day-1, 25-30% Day-7, 15-20% Day-30; medians 40%, 18% and 12%.

facts.claim: 37% of B2B software companies now run a hybrid pricing model, up from 25% twelve months earlier
facts.source_title: The 2026 State of B2B SaaS and AI Monetization Report
facts.excerpt: About two-in-five participants (37%) said they have a hybrid pricing model, up from 25% twelve months ago.
